H2400.def: intensively from «02398»; a criminal, or one accounted guilty:--offender, sinful, sinner.

H2401.def: feminine of «02399»; an offence, or a sacrifice for it:--sin (offering).

H2402.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02401»; an offence, and the penalty or sacrifice for it:--sin (offering).

H2403.def: or chattacth {khat-tawth'}; from «02398»; an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender:--punishment (of sin), purifying(-fication for sin), sin(-ner, offering).

H2404.def: a primitive root; to chop or carve wood:--cut down, hew(-er), polish.

H2405.def: feminine passive participle of «02404»; properly, a carving; hence, a tapestry (as figured):--carved.

H2406.def: of uncertain derivation; wheat, whether the grain or the plant:--wheat(-en).

H2407.et: from an unused root of uncertain signification
H2407.def: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites:--Hattush.

H2408.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02398»; an offence:--sin.

H2409.def: (Aramaic) from the same as «02408»; an expiation:--sin offering.

H2410.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to dig out
H2410.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to dig out; explorer; Chatita, a temple porter:--Hatita.

H2411.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to wave
H2411.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to wave; fluctuating; Chattil, one of "Solomon's servants":--Hattil.

H2412.def: from «02414»; robber; Chatipha, one of the Nethinim:--Hatipha.

H2414.def: a primitive root; to clutch; hence, to seize as a prisoner:--catch.

H2415.et: from an unused root of uncertain signification
H2415.def: from an unused root of uncertain signification; a twig:--rod.

H2416.def: from «02421»; alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively:--+ age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, + merry, multitude, + (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

H2417.def: (Aramaic) from «02418»; alive; also (as noun in plural) life:--life, that liveth, living.

H2418.def: (Aramaic) or chayah (Aramaic) {khah-yaw'}; corresponding to «02421»; to live:--live, keep alive.

H2419.def: from «02416» and «0410»; living of God; Chiel, an Israelite:--Hiel.

H2420.def: from «02330»; a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim:--dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

H2421.def: a primitive root (compare «02331», «02421»); to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive:--keep (leave, make) alive, × certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, (X God) save (alive, life, lives), × surely, be whole.

H2425.def: a primitive root (compare «02421»); to live; causatively to revive:--live, save life.

H2426.def: or (shortened) chel {khale}; a collateral form of «02428»; an army; also (by analogy,) an intrenchment:--army, bulwark, host, + poor, rampart, trench, wall.

H2427.def: and (feminine) chiylah {khee-law'}; from «02342»; a throe (expectant of childbirth):--pain, pang, sorrow.

H2428.def: from «02342»; probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength:--able, activity, (+) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, (+)valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

H2429.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02428»; an army, or strength:--aloud, army, × most (mighty), power.

H2431.def: or Cheleam {khay-lawm'}; from «02428»; fortress; Chelam, a place East of Palestine:--Helam.

H2432.def: from «02428»; fortress; Chilen, a place in Palestine:--Hilen.

H2435.def: from «02434»; properly, the (outer) wall side; hence, exterior; figuratively, secular (as opposed to sacred):--outer, outward, utter, without.

H2436.et: from an unused root, apparently meaning to inclose
H2436.def: or cheq {khake}; and chowq {khoke}; from an unused root, apparently meaning to inclose; the bosom (literally or figuratively):--bosom, bottom, lap, midst, within.

H2437.et: from (02357) in the sense of splendour
H2437.def: from «02357» in the sense of splendor; Chirah, an Adullamite:--Hirah.

H2438.def: or Chiyrowm {khee-rome'}; another form of «02361»; Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians:--Hiram, Huram.

H2439.def: another form of «02363»; to hurry:--make haste.

H2440.def: from «02439»; properly, a hurry; hence (adverb) quickly:--soon.

H2441.et: probably from (02596) in the sense of tasting
H2441.def: probably from «02596» in the sense of tasting; properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing):--(roof of the) mouth, taste.

H2442.et: a primitive root [apparently akin to (02707) through the idea of piercing]
H2442.def: a primitive root (apparently akin to «02707» through the idea of piercing); properly, to adhere to; hence, to await:--long, tarry, wait.

H2443.def: probably from «02442»; a hook (as adhering):--angle, hook.

H2444.def: from the same as «02447»; dark; Chakilah, a hill in Palestine:--Hachilah.

H2445.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02449»; wise, i.e. a Magian:--wise.

H2446.def: from the base of «02447» and «03050»; darkness of Jah; Chakaljah, an Israelite:--Hachaliah.

H2447.et: by reduplication from an unused root apparently meaning to be dark
H2447.def: by reduplication from an unused root apparently meaning to be dark; darkly flashing (only of the eyes); in a good sense, brilliant (as stimulated by wine):--red.

H2448.def: from «02447»; flash (of the eyes); in a bad sense, blearedness:--redness.

H2449.def: a primitive root, to be wise (in mind, word or act):--X exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser.

H2450.def: from «02449»; wise, (i.e. intelligent, skilful or artful):--cunning (man), subtil, ((un-)), wise((hearted), man).

H2451.def: from «02449»; wisdom (in a good sense):--skilful, wisdom, wisely, wit.

H2453.def: from «02449»; skilful; Chakmoni, an Israelite:--Hachmoni, Hachmonite.

H2454.def: or chakmowth {khak-moth'}; collateral forms of «02451»; wisdom:--wisdom, every wise (woman).

H2455.def: from «02490»; properly, exposed; hence, profane:--common, profane (place), unholy.

H2456.def: a primitive root (compare «02470»); to be sick:--be diseased.

H2458.def: the same as «02457»; Chelah, an Israelitess:--Helah.

H2459.et: from an unused root meaning to be fat
H2459.def: or cheleb {khay'-leb}; from an unused root meaning to be fat; fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part:--X best, fat(-ness), × finest, grease, marrow.

H2460.def: the same as «02459»; fatness; Cheleb, an Israelite:--Heleb.

H2461.def: from the same as «02459»; milk (as the richness of kine):--+ cheese, milk, sucking.

H2462.def: feminine of «02459»; fertility: Chelbah, a place in Palestine:--Helbah.

H2463.def: from «02459»; fruitful; Chelbon, a place in Syria:--Helbah.

H2464.def: from «02459»; galbanam, an odorous gum (as if fatty):--galbanum.

H2465.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to glide swiftly
H2465.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to glide swiftly; life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence, the world (as transient):--age, short time, world.

H2466.def: the same as «02465»; Cheled, an Israelite:--Heled.

H2467.def: from the same as «02465»; a weasel (from its gliding motion):--weasel.

H2469.def: from «02466»; worldliness; Cheldai, the name of two Israelites:--Heldai.

H2470.def: a primitive root (compare «02342», «02470», «02490»); properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat:--beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, × pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit (X supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.

H2473.def: or (shortened) Cholon {kho-lone'}; probably from «02344»; sandy; Cholon, the name of two places in Palestine:--Holon.

H2475.def: from «02498»; properly, surviving; by implication (collectively) orphans:--X destruction.

H2476.def: feminine passive participle of «02522»; defeat:--being overcome.

H2477.def: probably of foreign origin; Chalach, a region of Assyria:--Halah.

H2478.def: by reduplication from «02342»; contorted; Chalchul, a place in Palestine:--Halhul.

H2479.def: feminine from the same as «02478»; writhing (in childbirth); by implication, terror:--(great, much) pain.

H2480.def: a primitive root; to snatch at:--catch.

H2482.def: the same as «02481»; Chali, a place in Palestine:--Hali.

H2483.def: from «02470»; malady, anxiety, calamity:--disease, grief, (is) sick(-ness).

H2486.def: or chalilah {khaw-lee'-law}; a directive from «02490»; literal for a profaned thing; used (interj.) far be it!:--be far, (X God) forbid.

H2489.et: apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (fig.) unhappy
H2489.def: or chelkah {khay-lek-aw'}; apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (figuratively) unhappy; a wretch, i.e. unfortunate:--poor.

H2490.def: a primitive root (compare «02470»); properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an "opening wedge"); denom. (from «02485») to play (the flute):--begin (X men began), defile, × break, defile, × eat (as common things), × first, × gather the grape thereof, × take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

H2491.def: from «02490»; pierced (especially to death); figuratively, polluted:--kill, profane, slain (man), × slew, (deadly) wounded.

H2492.def: a primitive root; properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream:--(cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.

H2493.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02492»; a dream:--dream.

H2494.def: from «02492»; a dream; Chelem, an Israelite:--Helem. Compare «02469».

H2495.def: from «02492» (in the sense of insipidity); probably purslain:--egg.

H2496.et: probably from (02492) (in the sense of hardness)
H2496.def: probably from «02492» (in the sense of hardness); flint:--flint(-y), rock.

H2498.def: a primitive root; properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change:--abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.

H2499.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02498»; to pass on (of time):--pass.
